note: The owner's rules in force for the XAUUSD system, each with its source. Constitutional rules change only by a reviewed PR or an owner-approved amendment; operational rules follow the measured system through the Knowledge Council and Cerebrum (doctrine_protocol). Retired rules are kept for history and are never indexed.

rules.rule: No Worker places an order or can read a broker credential. Trades happen only on the owner's own MetaTrader 5 terminal: the owner's EA executes the decision it reads from the signal API, or the Omega bridge executes what Omega plans and sizes from the owner's risk setting, at most 2% of equity per trade. Omega plans nothing unless both its switch and its page toggle are on, a real account also needs the typed LIVE arm, a kill closes the positions, and the EA and the Omega executor never run on the same account. Aether, the kernel and learned knowledge stay advisory.

Omega plans nothing unless both its switch and its page toggle are on, a real account also needs the typed LIVE arm, a kill closes the positions, and the EA and the Omega executor never run on the same account. Aether, the kernel and learned knowledge stay advisory.
rules.source: xauusd AGENTS.md rule 8; docs/SSOT.md "MT5 Expert Advisor" and "Omega broker engine"; owner decisions 2026-11-09 (Langsung siap live, Omega memegang akses broker, Bridge di host ini, Mati sampai Anda aktifkan)

rules.rule: Reports to the platform kernel and decision cards to Aether never carry a price level, a size or order wording (entry, stop, target, zones, key levels, lots).

rules.rule: Calls to the platform kernel use RPC Service Bindings without shared secrets; reports are info or warning, never critical; a denial is final (no retry, no switching agent ids).

rules.rule: Local engine trust comes only from the autonomous parity registry (24 consecutive candles that match TradingView); nothing is marked verified by hand, and the Pine sources and hashed engines are never edited. The local lane is the decision lane (local); TradingView webhooks only calibrate it.

rules.rule: When the evidence is missing the answer is WAIT, never a guess. A room without a usable closed candle or without its quorum decides WAIT. The Decision Engine gives WAIT when any guardrail fails; when the council fails or answers invalidly, the strategy engine's decision stands only if its side passes every guardrail, otherwise WAIT. A closed market is always WAIT.

rules.rule: Learned knowledge is labelled as learned, cites its evidence, and never redefines a field or a rule of the canon. The doctrine changes only through a reviewed PR or an amendment Cerebrum executed (doctrine_protocol), never from learned knowledge.

rules.rule: No change to an engine parameter, a prompt or a knowledge item is promoted automatically: candidates run in shadow, are judged by outcome scoring with a significance test, and the owner approves a separate promotion PR. Two things change without an operator: the room quorum weighting (weighting_auto) and operational doctrine amendments inside their hard bounds that Cerebrum executed (doctrine_protocol).

rules.rule: The doctrine follows the measured system through the Knowledge Council. Once a day its Nexus, Omega and Aether seats compare every rule's anchored facts with what the running system reports; a difference the reporting seat measured twice, at least 45 minutes apart, and the Aether seat validated, is proposed to the Cerebrum consensus. Cerebrum votes and executes it: an operational fact inside its hard bounds after the vote, anything else after one owner approval. Aether applies only amendments Cerebrum executed and folds them into the canon by a reviewed PR. No seat changes the doctrine by itself.

rules.rule: The Decision Engine is the single decision. At every 15m close one AI council, the only reader across the timeframes, chooses BUY, SELL or WAIT from witnesses that each judge from their own data, weighted D1 room 0.1469, 4H room 0.1469, 1H room 0.1469, 15m room 0.1103, News Daily 0.0735, Macro War Room 0.0367, strategy engine 0.0735, key levels 0.0459, regime 0.0459, cross-timeframe trend 0.0459, macro drivers 0.0276, session 0.02, economic calendar inside a release's horizon 0.08; a missing or stale witness drops out and the rest renormalise. It decides inside deterministic guardrails it cannot break (market_open, fresh, quorum, no_veto, levels, reward, confidence); a BUY or SELL that breaks one becomes WAIT. Prices come only from the Key Level Agent's plan, never from a model. Its decision feeds the EA, Omega, Telegram, the Signal Ledger and Nexus.

It decides inside deterministic guardrails it cannot break ({decision.guardrails}); a BUY or SELL that breaks one becomes WAIT. Prices come only from the Key Level Agent's plan, never from a model. Its decision feeds the EA, Omega, Telegram, the Signal Ledger and Nexus.
rules.source: xauusd docs/SSOT.md, Decision Engine; src/decision-engine.mjs; owner decisions 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-10; 2026-11-12: the CALENDAR witness at 0.08 inside a release's horizon, the others scaled to make room

rules.rule: In the intraday mode the Decision Engine's BUY or SELL needs more than 50% of the witnesses' weight on its side, or a lean of at least 0.15 with more weight than the other side; no veto; a plan from the key levels paying at least 1.5R to its target; and a confidence of at least 0.4. The trading mode (scalp, intraday or swing) sets these thresholds.
rules.template: In the {decision.trading_mode} mode the Decision Engine's BUY or SELL needs more than {decision.quorum_min} of the witnesses' weight on its side, or a lean of at least {decision.lean} with more weight than the other side; no veto; a plan from the key levels paying at least {decision.min_rrr}R to its target; and a confidence of at least {decision.min_confidence}. The trading mode (scalp, intraday or swing) sets these thresholds.
rules.source: xauusd src/decision-engine.mjs guardrailsFor and decide; owner decision 2026-11-10 (trading modes)

rules.rule: The rooms decide by their own quorum, without a confirmation gate, and so does the Decision Engine (its confirmation gate is off): the confirmation candle is the trigger of a market order (prophet_candle_for_market_orders_broker_5m). A market order waits for a broker 5m Prophet confirmation on its side within 3 broker 5m bars after the decision, once the broker's 5m lane is ready and fresh; until then, or while it is stale, a verified 5m or a 15m Prophet confirmation on its side, the one the decision recorded or one printed since. A TradingView 5m confirmation counts only while the 5m Prophet implementation is parity-approved; the broker's 5m is not parity-verified (its bars differ from OANDA's by the basis). A limit order at the key level waits only for price.

rules.rule: The H1 decision is the quorum of the 1H War Room: BUY or SELL only when the moderator concluded it and more than the room's quorum share (default 50%, tuned by weighting_auto) of the weight of the agents who spoke holds the matching bias, with prices from the 1H plan; otherwise WAIT. Indicator signals are the agents' arguments, never gates or vetoes. The H1 decision is one witness of the Decision Engine; it drives the EA and Telegram only while the Decision Engine is off.

rules.rule: Every timeframe's room is independent: its agents read only that timeframe's own data, never another timeframe's room, desk or decision and never another agent; the Consensus Discussion stays inside each timeframe over an anonymous bus, and every answer names the metrics it decided from, never an agent. Only the Decision Engine's council reads across the timeframes.

rules.rule: Every opening states its action and its bias (BULLISH, BEARISH or NEUTRAL): the direction its own data leans, even when the action is WAIT.

rules.rule: Agents never mention calibration, parity or verification in their text; readers see each agent's calibration status once, next to its name. In the Live War Room 15m an agent with no calibrated statement speaks at confidence 0.4 or lower; the 1H, 4H and D1 rooms have no such cap.

rules.rule: The quorum weighting of every room is tuned automatically per timeframe over a reviewed grid (auto mode): xauusd activates a point its replay rates better on discovery and holdout, at most once every 7 days, rolls a worse one back after 100 rooms of reverse shadow, and tells the owner on Telegram. Aether audits the reports and proposes nothing.

rules.rule: A High-impact USD event, from 120 minutes before to 30 minutes after it, is a caution in the decision, never a forced WAIT; the EA and Omega make no new entry in that window. After a release with its value, the Calendar Agent's bias follows the surprise within the event's learned horizon.

After a release with its value, the Calendar Agent's bias follows the surprise within the event's learned horizon.
rules.source: xauusd src/econ-calendar.mjs EVENT_GATE, src/ea-signal.mjs; owner decisions 2026-11-08 and 2026-11-10

rules.rule: Omega opens at most once per signal, before it expires and within 10 minutes of the decision, outside the event blackout and the daily rollover quarantine (21:55-22:15 UTC), at a spread of at most 60 points, with fewer than 1 open positions and above the daily loss limit of 2% of the day's starting balance. It risks 0.5% of equity at the stop and keeps the plan's distances from the broker's own price; a position against the signal is closed.

It risks {omega.risk_pct}% of equity at the stop and keeps the plan's distances from the broker's own price; a position against the signal is closed.

Aether, its reports and its learned knowledge stay advisory.
